title: Speicher page frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter in a content file. Stripped before rendering, never emitted as content. Parsed with YAML 1.2 core schema. Frontmatter NEVER affects access — an `access` key is rejected, not warned.

title.description: Overrides the H1, then the de-slugged filename.

description.description: Search snippet fallback and meta description. Indexed.

icon.description: Name of a Lucide icon (https://lucide.dev/icons), kebab-case, e.g. "book-open". Shown beside the page in navigation and folder listings. Validated against the bundled icon set at ingest: an unknown name warns and is dropped rather than failing the sync, since an icon is cosmetic. The name selects from icons Speicher ships — no SVG from the repository is ever rendered.

redirect_from.description: Former paths that should redirect here. Must be within the same repo, must not collide with a live path, and lose to a live slug exactly as retired slug-history redirects do.

draft.description: true excludes the file from ingest entirely.

indexable.description: Narrowing only: true -> false is honoured, false -> true is ignored.

tags.description: Free-form tags relating this page to others. Case-folded for matching, shown as written. They have no effect on access whatsoever: a tag is only ever visible through a page the reader can already read, and a listing of a tag contains only such pages. Tagging a page does not widen it, and cannot — the cascade is the only thing that decides who may read anything.

sidebar_position.description: Docusaurus's sidebar ordering key, read for import compatibility only. Speicher's own ordering mechanism is the numeric filename prefix; this key is consulted per folder, and only where no sibling in that folder carries a prefix. `sidebar.order` is the Starlight spelling of the same thing.

sidebar.description: Starlight's sidebar block. Only `order` is read, on the same terms as `sidebar_position`. The rest of the block belongs to Starlight and is left alone rather than warned about — Speicher does not own this key.

order.description: Starlight's sibling ordering key. Read exactly as `sidebar_position` is.

$comment: Access keys are rejected rather than ignored. Per-file grants were cut in favour of directory granularity; permitting them here would reintroduce them and add a fourth cascade level with different semantics.
